text:
Emma Li: quick sync — want to follow up on the admission/operator split from the pool-autoscale RFC. thinking about introducing "gpu-slice" hints so control-plane can request fractional capacity without making operator store fractional state.

Emma Li: sketch: 
```
POST /admit
{
  "tenant": "acct-123",
  "req": { "gpu_slices": 0.25, "seq_len": 1024 },
  "hint": { "slice_grant": 2, "offer_duration_s": 300 }
}
```

Emma Li: operator would still manage integer slots; control-plane translates slices into slot offers and maintains accounting. pros: simpler operator, central policy. cons: potential fragmentation + cache effects.

Raj Patel: pretty neat. question: eviction semantics? billing? if we pack 4x0.25 slices into one gpu, who gets charged when preempted?

Sylvia Gomez: billing stays per-token. capacity accounting is orthogonal. control-plane can refund headroom credits when preempted; important to emit refund events for billing reconciliation.

Chris O'Neill: operator complexity concern: if we let control-plane reassign fractional claims, operator must still enforce isolation boundaries (cgroups or MIG). i'd rather operator stay integer-only and accept a "weight" on slots, not fractional slot objects.

Raj Patel: agree with Chris. implement greedy packer in control-plane: accumulate slice weights, fill slots, emit packing plan. fragmentation risk but easier to iterate.

Emma Li: proposal: two admission flavors: "hard-slice" (operator-aware, requires explicit slot-sharing primitives) and "soft-pack" (control-plane packs slices into integer slots, allows preemption).

Sylvia Gomez: also need model-based caps. KV/cache-heavy models shouldn't be slice-packed aggressively. add model profile constraint: "min_slice": 1 for high-kv models.

Chris O'Neill: add observability: metrics: slice_offer_rate, pack_utilization, fragment_percent, preempt_refunds. add trace for pack decisions.

orch-bot: link: RFC-2345 (pool-autoscale) referenced; automated note: created ticket INF-1823 to track packer POC.

Emma Li: action items: i'll draft API patch + control-plane packer POC (simple greedy). Raj + Sylvia review headroom/refund flow. Chris can prototype operator integer-weight API.

Raj Patel: sgtm :thumbsup:

Sylvia Gomez: +1. watch cache regressions in canary.

Chris O'Neill: i'll add a sim job: `./tools/sim packer --tenants=100 --trace=kv` and run against the harness.

Emma Li: target canary next week if we have POC metric surface. thanks all.
